name: TC-425: the public gate — flipping onlineBookingEnabled off refuses create, restored in finally
description: With TABLE_RESERVATIONS granted but onlineBookingEnabled:false, public create → 403 RESERVATIONS_NOT_ENABLED (the SAME code the entitlement-missing case uses — a satellite client hides the booking widget on one code regardless of which half of the gate failed). Restored ON in `finally`.
